Step Description: BEFORE YOU START: Log in to https://lively-bush-0ed75ca10.7.azurestaticapps.net using your Administrator account.
Confirm you see Administrator in the role badge on the home screen.
Expected Result: Role badge reads Administrator

Step Description: Open the app and sign in.
Expected Result: Home screen loads. You see a greeting with your first name.

Step Description: Check the role badge below your name.
Expected Result: Badge reads "Administrator"

Step Description: Count the module cards on the home screen.
Expected Result: You see at least: Daily Check, Vehicle & Equipment Status, Check History, Station Administration, Compliance Dashboard

Step Description: Look at the colored station band near the top of the screen.
Expected Result: A colored band shows the name of a station you belong to.

Step Description: Open Station Administration from the home screen.
Expected Result: The admin panel opens. You see station buttons and a list of nav cards.

Step Description: Look for a small button at the bottom of the station list.
Expected Result: You see a low-key text button that says something like "+ Add Station"

Step Description: Tap that button.
Expected Result: A short form appears below the station list (no pop-up window).

Step Description: Try to submit the form without filling in a Name.
Expected Result: You get a red error message on the Name field.

Step Description: Fill in Name: UAT Test Station. Leave Address blank and try to submit.
Expected Result: You get a red error on the Address field.

Step Description: Fill in Name: UAT Test Station, Address: 123 Main St, Region: Michigan. Pick any color swatch. Add a call sign: UAT.
Test Data / Setup Needed: Name: UAT Test Station, Address: 123 Main St, Region: Michigan, Color: any, Call sign: UAT
Expected Result: Station is created. The form disappears. You now see UAT Test Station in the station list.

Step Description: Tap UAT Test Station to select it.
Expected Result: The admin panel updates. You see nav cards for UAT Test Station.

Step Description: Look at the colored stripe on the UAT Test Station button.
Expected Result: The color stripe matches what you picked.

Step Description: Tap the Cancel button on the Add Station form (start again if needed).
Expected Result: The form disappears. The + Add Station button comes back.

Step Description: With UAT Test Station selected tap Members.
Expected Result: Member list opens. It is empty because this is a new station.

Step Description: Tap Add Member. Enter the email address for your test Responder account, and set Role to Responder.
Expected Result: Member appears in the list with a green Responder badge.

Step Description: Add a second member: your Supervisor test account, Role: Supervisor.
Expected Result: Supervisor appears in the list with a blue Supervisor badge.

Step Description: Reload the page. Navigate back to Members for UAT Test Station.
Expected Result: Both members still appear. No data was lost.

Step Description: Look at the member list for Newberg Township Station (switch stations).
Expected Result: Members for Newberg Township are shown. UAT Test Station members are NOT mixed in.

Step Description: Select Newberg Township Station. Tap Vehicles.
Expected Result: Vehicle list opens. Unit 712 is shown.

Step Description: Look for an Add Vehicle button or form.
Expected Result: You can add a new vehicle.

Step Description: Add a test vehicle: Number TEST-UAT. Type BLS.
Expected Result: Vehicle TEST-UAT appears in the list.

Step Description: Expand the TEST-UAT vehicle card.
Expected Result: Color picker section and Compartments section appear below the card.

Step Description: Pick a color swatch for TEST-UAT (try the red swatch, or any distinct color).
Expected Result: A color dot appears in the TEST-UAT card header.

Step Description: Reload the page. Open Vehicles again. Expand TEST-UAT.
Expected Result: The color dot is still showing. Color was saved.

Step Description: With TEST-UAT expanded tap Add Compartment.
Expected Result: A small form appears to name the compartment.

Step Description: Name the compartment: PC 1 (Airway). Save it.
Expected Result: Compartment appears in the TEST-UAT list.

Step Description: Tap the PC 1 (Airway) compartment to open its par level list.
Expected Result: A per-item list shows for that compartment. It will be empty at first.

Step Description: Add a par level: Item = NRB Mask, Min = 4, Max = 10.
Expected Result: NRB Mask appears in the compartment with Min 4 Max 10.

Step Description: Add another par level: Item = BVM, Min = 1, Max = 2.
Expected Result: BVM appears in the list.

Step Description: Try to add NRB Mask again to the same compartment.
Expected Result: You get an error: already assigned to this compartment. No duplicate is created.

Step Description: Try to save a par level with Max less than Min (for example Min 5 Max 3).
Expected Result: You get a validation error: Max must be at or above Min.
Tester Notes: It changed it to Min 2 and Max 4

Step Description: Open the par level list for Unit 712, compartment PC 8 (the AED/LUCAS compartment).
Expected Result: Par level list shows items including AED Battery and LUCAS Device.

Step Description: Find the AED Battery row. Look for a Priority checkbox or toggle.
Expected Result: Priority flag is checked. A question field shows something like: AED shows READY?

Step Description: Find the LUCAS Device row.
Expected Result: Priority flag is checked. Question shows: LUCAS shows READY?

Step Description: Add a new par level to PC 8, check the Priority box, and type a custom question: O2 shows above 500 PSI?
Test Data / Setup Needed: Priority: checked, Question: O2 shows above 500 PSI?
Expected Result: Row saves with the priority flag and custom question.
Tester Notes: When I go back to look if it saved, it doesn't show that it was changed.  Users need feedback!  It did save the change and show's properly on the Daily Check

Step Description: Remove the test par level you just added (tap the X or Remove button).
Expected Result: Row disappears from the list.

Step Description: In the par level list for PC 1 (Airway) on TEST-UAT, find the BVM row.
Test Data / Setup Needed: Par levels already added in step ADM-29
Expected Result: BVM row is shown.

Step Description: Tap the Remove (X) button next to BVM. When asked for a reason, enter: UAT test removal.
Expected Result: BVM disappears from the active list.

Step Description: Look for a way to see removed/inactive par levels (a toggle or filter).
Expected Result: If available, BVM row appears with a deactivated badge.
Tester Notes: I don't think we have this functionality.  It is better that it is gone than shows deactivated.

Step Description: Tap Items (from the admin nav cards for any station).
Expected Result: Item catalog opens. You see a list of items.

Step Description: Type NRB in the search box.
Expected Result: NRB Mask appears in results. Other items not matching NRB are hidden.

Step Description: Clear the search.
Expected Result: All items return.

Step Description: Tap a filter chip like "Consumable" or a check type.
Expected Result: Only items with that type are shown.

Step Description: Clear the filter.
Expected Result: All items return.

Step Description: Tap + Add Item.
Expected Result: Item creation form opens.

Step Description: Fill in: Name = UAT Test Item, Check Type = Supply (count), Unit = each. Save.
Expected Result: UAT Test Item appears in the catalog.

Step Description: Tap Edit on UAT Test Item.
Expected Result: Edit form opens with fields pre-filled.

Step Description: Change the name to UAT Test Item v2. Save.
Test Data / Setup Needed: New name: UAT Test Item v2
Expected Result: Item name updates in the catalog.

Step Description: Look for a Show Inactive Items toggle (Admin-only feature).
Expected Result: Toggle is visible. When off the catalog shows only active items.

Step Description: Find the Deactivate button on UAT Test Item v2 and deactivate it.
Test Data / Setup Needed: UAT Test Item v2 in catalog
Expected Result: Item disappears from the active list.

Step Description: Turn on the Show Inactive Items toggle.
Expected Result: UAT Test Item v2 reappears with an Inactive badge.
Tester Notes: The item "UAT Test Item v2" did not show in the list.

Step Description: Select Newberg Township Station. Open Station Administration > Supply Room (or Station Supplies).
Expected Result: Supply room interface opens. You see shelves with items.

Step Description: If the supply room has not been set up yet, tap Set Up Supply Room.
Expected Result: Supply room is created. Shelf 1 through Shelf 4 appear.

Step Description: Open the par levels for Shelf 1 on the supply room.
Expected Result: Par level list for Shelf 1 shows.

Step Description: Add a par level to Shelf 1: Item = NRB Mask, Min = 20, Max = 50.
Expected Result: NRB Mask appears on Shelf 1 with those quantities.
Tester Notes: Items can be added, but I only see one because the search box is getting cut off.

Step Description: Open Settings from the admin panel (or home screen).
Expected Result: Settings screen opens.

Step Description: Find the Allow Check Modification toggle.
Expected Result: Toggle is shown. Its current state (on or off) is readable.
Tester Notes: Toggle is there, but the wording is white.  Makes it very hard to see. Please use the propper CSS formatting

Step Description: Turn the toggle off. Reload the page and return to Settings.
Expected Result: Setting shows Off. The change was saved.

Step Description: Turn the toggle back on.
Expected Result: Setting returns to On.

Step Description: In the Vehicles section for Newberg Township tap TEST-UAT.
Expected Result: TEST-UAT card expands.

Step Description: Look for a Retire button near the bottom of the card or in settings.
Expected Result: Retire button is visible. (Note: retiring TEST-UAT is safe -- it is a test vehicle.)
Tester Notes: The Retire button is formatted incorrectly.  Please use the proper CSS formatting for buttons.

Step Description: Tap Retire. Enter a reason: UAT cleanup.
Expected Result: You are asked to confirm. After confirming TEST-UAT disappears from the active vehicle list.

Step Description: Look for a Retired section or toggle in the Vehicles list.
Expected Result: TEST-UAT appears in the retired list with your reason shown.

Step Description: Switch to UAT Test Station in the admin panel.
Expected Result: Admin panel updates. Nav cards are for UAT Test Station.

Step Description: Open Members for UAT Test Station.
Expected Result: Only UAT Test Station members are shown. Newberg Township members are not mixed in.

Step Description: Open Vehicles for UAT Test Station.
Expected Result: No Unit 712 here. Only UAT Test Station vehicles shown.

Step Description: Switch back to Newberg Township Station.
Expected Result: Admin panel shows Newberg Township data.

Step Description: Return to the home screen. Open Check History or look for an Audit section (Supervisor+ feature).
Expected Result: Audit log is accessible from the compliance dashboard or settings area.

Step Description: Browse the audit log entries.
Expected Result: You can see recent actions like member adds and item changes.

Step Description: If a date filter is available, enter a From date of today.
Expected Result: Only entries from today are shown.

Step Description: Delete or retire any test data created during this test run (UAT Test Station can remain for now).
Expected Result: Test data is removed or marked retired. Production data for Newberg Township is untouched.
